summary: Frontend-only test of the Transit leg flow on test-user-pro / main (TEST_Kia Ora) at 430x900. Every requested feature passed (7/7). BLOCKER FOUND AND WORKED AROUND: the pro main boat had no Leaving Dock, Arriving at Destination or Returning to Dock lists in its registry or data. They were not in deleted_lists either, and the registry was last changed 2026-11-21, so the DEPART flow could not be reached. I copied these 3 lists (registry entries plus unticked items) from test-user-free/model_vessel into test-user-pro/main, then tested. Results: 1) The Trip Planning yellow hint transit-hint-leg-1 has the exact text and a yellow background (rgb 254,240,138). Its link opens Arriving at Destination. 2) DEPART goes through Confirm levels to the About to depart window. The depart-leg-types box has 3 rows: Leg 1 Mana Island · Transiting, Leg 2 Tawa Bay · Mooring, Leg 3 Mana Marina · Returning to Dock. Changing Leg 2 to Anchoring updates the label live, Mooring sets it back, and Depart now shows the toast 'Underway on Trip Planning...'. 3) After departing, Arriving at Destination shows vessel-arrived-all-done-btn as 'LOG PASSING TRANSIT 2' (CSS uppercase) and the hint reads Next step: 'LOG PASSING TRANSIT 2'. The button opens transit-dialog and not all-done-dialog, and there is no transit-passed-btn on that list. 4) Leaving Dock, Returning to Dock and Trip Planning show transit-passed-btn 'Passing Mana Island' with no ARRIVED card button, and it opens the same transit window. 5) The transit window title is 'Log passing transit 2: Mana Island'. Neither its text nor its HTML contains 'arriv'. The bold (700) line reads 'An auto depart from TRANSIT 2 will be created (Next stop Tawa Bay, mooring).' The time defaults to now and the offset reads 'Logged now, with the transit GPS.' Setting the time 30 min earlier shows 'Transit logged 31 min late: ...flagged as approximate.' Set to Now resets it. The confirm button is yellow (rgb 253,224,71) 'TRANSITING THROUGH', and Cancel closes without logging. 6) Confirming shows the toast 'Passing transit 2 Mana Island logged in the Ship's Log. Underway to Tawa Bay'. The boat stays UNDERWAY, the trip line reads 'Mana Island to Tawa Bay', the button returns to 'ARRIVED, ALL ARRIVAL CHECKS DONE' and the hint to 'Next step: perform arrival checks, and click "ARRIVED"'. The Ship's Log has 'Passing transit 2 Mana Island at 25/11/2026 21:42 - Route Plan: Trip Planning - next stop Tawa Bay, Mooring (Transit GPS: UNKNOWN, logged 31 min late so approximate)' and 'Mana Island to Tawa Bay, departure 25/11/2026 21:42 - Auto departure from transit 2 Mana Island - Route Plan: Trip Planning - next stop Tawa Bay, Mooring'. Both are confirmed in the UI and in /api/me/boat. 7) The Planned route window shows Leg 1 DEPARTED, Mana Island 'PASSED 25/11/2026 21:42' Transit point, and Leg 2 'DEPARTED 25/11/2026 21:42'.

ui_bugs.issue: A transit time earlier than the leg's own departure is accepted. In the test the departure was 22:11 and the transit was logged at 21:42. Leg 1 then gets arrived_at before its departure 'at', and the route window shows Leg 2 DEPARTED 21:42 before Leg 1 DEPARTED 22:11. Consider warning about, or clamping, a transit time before the leg's departure.

The time input only keeps minutes, but the offset is measured from Date.now() including seconds. Setting the time exactly 30 min earlier often reads '31 min late'. Measuring against the current minute (floor of now to the minute) would fix it.

issues: Transit date and time uses the browser's native date and time inputs (the shared When component), not a shadcn picker. This matches the rest of the app.

action_items: DATA: test-user-pro/main was missing the leavingDock, arrivingDest and returningDock lists, with no record in deleted_lists. Find out how they were lost (seed or earlier restore?). The tester re-added them by copying from test-user-free/model_vessel (registry entries and items, list_ts and sec_ts.registry set to now). A 'New Master items' banner now shows on Arriving at Destination. Remove or keep them as you see fit.
Optional: validate that the transit time is not before the current leg's departure.
Optional: compute the offset to the minute so '30 min' does not show as '31 min'.
critical_code_review_comments: BoatPrep.jsx is 1650+ lines. It should be split.
The mbp:open-list listener useEffect has empty deps and captures the first-render pickList. It works now because pickList only calls setters, but it is fragile.
passTransit sets the auto-departure leg's 'at' to the transit time, not to now. That is intended, but it can come before the previous leg's departure (see the ui_bugs entry).
seed_data_creation: Added the leavingDock, arrivingDest and returningDock lists to test-user-pro/main (copied from test-user-free/model_vessel, script /tmp/add_lists.py). The departure and transit were logged on the seeded trip, as allowed: the boat is now underway on Leg 2 Mana Island to Tawa Bay, with 4 new Ship's Log entries and boat.legs.routeHazards holding 2 legs. Main agent to restore from /tmp/pro_main_backup.json. Snapshot taken before testing: /tmp/boat_before.json.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use a 430x900 viewport with cookie session_token=test_session_pro_1, go to /app and press Escape 3 times. List selector: [data-testid=list-selector], then [data-testid=list-option-{id}] (routeHazards, leavingDock, arrivingDest, returningDock, shipsLog). The route window opens from [data-testid={list}-hop-view-btn]. The levels pop-up uses level-confirm-{fuel|gas|water|bat_engine|bat_house}-3q, then levels-confirm-btn. The transit time input is [data-testid=transit-at-time-input] (native time input).
